settings_form_error_type: This value isn't the right kind. Enter a new one, or reset it.
settings_form_error_socket_addr: Enter an address and a port, like 0.0.0.0:8090 or [::]:8090.
settings_form_error_url: Enter a web address that starts with http:// or https://.
settings_form_error_host: Enter a host name or an IP address, like nas.local or 192.168.1.5.
settings_form_error_time_range: Enter a start and an end in 24-hour time, like 03:00-05:00. A window can run past midnight, like 22:00-02:00.
settings_form_error_time_range_same: The window starts and ends at the same time. Choose a different end.
settings_form_error_needs_confirmation: This change needs a confirmation this screen can't show, so nothing was saved. Make it from its own Settings screen.
settings_form_error_schema: This screen and Lodestar don't agree about a setting, so nothing was saved. Reload the page, then try again.
settings_form_error_server: Lodestar couldn't save the change. Your changes are kept; try again.
settings_form_offline: Couldn't reach Lodestar. Your changes are kept.
settings_form_note_locked: Your change was dropped: this setting can no longer be changed in the app.
settings_form_note_locked_env: Your change was dropped: {variable} now sets this setting.
settings_form_announce_saved_restart: Saved. Some changes apply after a restart.
settings_form_announce_undo_stale: Undo isn't possible any more: these settings were changed since. The current values are shown.
settings_form_announce_merged: These settings were changed elsewhere. Your changes are kept; review them and save again.
settings_form_announce_conflicts: Some settings were changed elsewhere. Choose which value to keep, then save again.
settings_form_announce_removed: Settings that no longer exist were left out of your changes: {count}.
settings_form_env_help: To change it, edit the variable in the container template or the environment, then restart Lodestar.
settings_form_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it instead.
settings_form_pending_reset: Goes back to the default when you save.
settings_form_secret_remove_body: Lodestar forgets the saved value at once. This can't be undone: to use it again, you'll need to enter it again.
settings_form_json_invalid: This isn't valid JSON yet. Check the brackets, commas and quotes.
settings_form_discard_body: Your changes on this screen are lost. The saved settings stay as they are.
settings_form_disruptive_fields: This changes {fields}, which interrupts what Lodestar is doing.
settings_form_disruptive_url: Lodestar will be at {url} after a restart.
settings_form_disruptive_generic: Crawling or search may stop until Lodestar restarts.
settings_form_leave_body: Changes on this screen aren't saved yet ({count}).
settings_form_summary_title: Nothing was saved. Fix these first:
settings_form_draft_title: You have unsaved changes from earlier
settings_form_draft_body: Restore them to keep editing, or discard them.
settings_form_draft_dropped: Restore them to keep editing, or discard them. Some no longer apply and are left out: {count}.
settings_form_busy: Lodestar is busy. Your changes are kept; try again in {seconds} seconds.
settings_form_draft_failed: Your unsaved changes from earlier couldn't load. They're kept: check your connection, then retry.
settings_form_chunk_failed: Part of this page couldn't load. Check your connection, then reload the page.
settings_form_load_error: Couldn't load these settings. Check that Lodestar is running, then retry.
settings_general_data_dir_help: The directory used by this installation.
settings_network_http_bind_help: The address and port used by the web interface.
settings_network_dht_port_help: The UDP port used for peer discovery.
settings_network_dht_enabled_help: Allow discovery through the distributed hash table.
settings_crawler_intensity_help: Choose how much work the crawler schedules.
settings_crawler_encryption_help: Choose the encryption policy for peer connections.
settings_crawler_timeout_secs_help: Maximum time allowed for a metadata fetch.
settings_crawler_max_metadata_mib_help: Reject metadata larger than this limit.
settings_transport_utp_help: Fetch metadata over uTP (BEP 29) as well as TCP. Not active yet: uTP has no effect until a later release, so changing this only changes what is saved.
settings_transport_fallback_to_tcp_label: Fall back to TCP (not active yet)
settings_transport_fallback_to_tcp_help: When a uTP connection fails, try the peer over TCP. Not active yet: uTP has no effect until a later release, so changing this only changes what is saved.
settings_storage_archive_raw_help: Keep metadata archives for later use.
settings_search_heap_mib_help: Memory available for building the search index.
settings_preferences_language_help: Automatic follows your browser. Or choose a language.
settings_preferences_time_zone_help: Empty follows your browser. Or enter a name such as Europe/Berlin.
settings_preferences_first_day_of_week_h: Where calendars start. Automatic follows the language.
settings_screen_language_purpose: Language, time zone and the first day of the week.
settings_screen_time_zone_unknown: That time zone isn't known. Pick one from the list, such as Europe/Berlin.
settings_trackers_help: Public trackers Lodestar asks how many peers a torrent has.
settings_integrations_help: Download clients and a Torznab endpoint.
settings_notifications_help: Where alerts, updates and health messages go.
settings_insights_help: The digest and the optional log of searches.
settings_trackers_scrape_help: Turn off to stop all tracker scrapes. Applies after a restart.
settings_trackers_trackers_help: One address per tracker. Use public trackers only: a private tracker’s passkey does not belong here.
settings_trackers_dht_scrape_help: Use the DHT as well as trackers to count peers.
settings_trackers_interval_secs_help: How often a torrent is checked. Automatic picks a sensible rate.
settings_trackers_http_interval_secs_hel: How often HTTP trackers are asked. Automatic picks a sensible rate.
settings_integrations_clients_help: The clients Lodestar can send a torrent to. Up to eight.
settings_integrations_default_client_hel: The client used when none is named. Empty uses the first.
settings_integrations_torznab_url_help: A Torznab endpoint, such as one from Prowlarr. Leave empty for none.
settings_integrations_torznab_api_key_he: Stored sealed. It is never shown again, and only sent to the address it was saved with.
settings_notifications_ntfy_url_help: Your ntfy topic address. Kept secret.
settings_notifications_ntfy_token_help: Only if your ntfy server needs one.
settings_notifications_ntfy_priority_hel: 1 is lowest, 5 highest. Automatic keeps ntfy’s default.
settings_notifications_ntfy_allow_privat: Allow ntfy on your own network.
settings_notifications_email_host_help: The SMTP server that sends the email.
settings_notifications_email_allow_priva: Allow a mail server on your own network.
settings_notifications_webhook_url_help: Lodestar posts a small JSON message here.
settings_notifications_webhook_allow_pri: Allow a webhook on your own network.
settings_insights_digest_help: A summary of what Lodestar found. Off, every day or every week.
settings_insights_digest_day_help: The day a weekly digest is sent.
settings_insights_digest_hour_help: The hour it is sent, in your time zone (0–23).
settings_insights_digest_channels_help: Channels you set up in Notifications, or the RSS feed.
settings_insights_query_logging_help: Keeps what is searched, to show top queries in Insights. Off by default.
settings_insights_query_retention_days_h: Days a logged search is kept, 1 to 30.
settings_integrations_clients_keywords: download client qbittorrent transmission deluge rtorrent aria2 send
settings_screen_trackers_purpose: Which trackers Lodestar asks for peer counts, and how often.
settings_screen_integrations_purpose: Download clients and Torznab, each with a connection test.
settings_screen_notifications_purpose: Channels Lodestar can message, each with a test, and which events go where.
settings_screen_insights_purpose: The digest, the optional search log and clearing usage data.
settings_screen_test_unreachable: Lodestar couldn’t run the test. Check that it is running, then try again.
settings_screen_test_need_email: Enter a mail server, a sender and at least one recipient first.
settings_screen_clients_empty: No download client yet. Add one to send torrents from Lodestar.
settings_screen_client_url_help: Where the client’s web interface is, such as http://192.168.1.5:8080/.
settings_screen_client_password_help: Saved on its own, sealed, and never shown again.
settings_screen_client_password_unsaved: Save the client first, then save its password here. You can test with it now.
settings_screen_privacy_what: Lodestar will save the text of each search and when it happened, so Insights can show your top queries.
settings_screen_privacy_where: It stays on this computer, in Lodestar’s own database. Nothing is sent anywhere.
settings_screen_privacy_days: Each search is deleted after {days} days. You can clear them at any time.
settings_screen_usage_help: Deletes every logged search. Settings are kept.
settings_screen_usage_empty: There is no usage data to clear.
settings_screen_client_password_pending: Not saved yet. Press Save password: Save changes does not include it.
